data: Good game, highly recommend (especially if you can get it on sale)
10/10 very fun and challenging and great to pass the time <3
Overall, this is a very fun game with great replayability
Overall, great game with fantastic and fun graphics, lots of humour and keeps you busy for hours :-)
Great gameplay mechanics and overall great fun
I would not recommend this game for the price point
I'm giving it a negative review because the game just runs so slow in later levels making it getting to be unplayable
I'm locked out of in game content because of this, so no, i do not recommend this game anymore
One of the best games I've played in a while. It's so much fun and the DLC's I've bought have been perfect additions to the main game.

what's not to love. its really well made, cute and detailed. there is only one single thing annoying about it. and it's how to specialize your staff. you've got to click on everything you don't or do want them to do singly. every time again and again.. I'd love hard to be able to save some templates. like: diagnostics only, treatment only, ward only and so on... but aside from that, go, buy and play! it's really fun

This game is a lot of fun for many hours. It also gets regular updates.

I just don't like the steep learning curve towards the end (without DLCs). I really don't know what I could do differently. I buy only the most necessary stuff, pay only the necessary wages, but my income decreases more and more until I lose the game. This seems unbalanced to the hospitals I played before (or was the balance more on the side of the gamer before?). This is why I wouldn't play it again so soon and wouldn't buy any DLCs.
Simple UI that isn't too overwhelming. Its easy to get sucked in and forget about that load of laundry.

As a fan of the old School Theme Hospital i can tell you that this game is the same, and thats a very good thing. The strange kind of humor, quirky machines, it all ads up in a fantastic formula. The designers and developer really nailed it.

This is a very good iteration of Theme Hospital, and I'm so glad the stayed true to the formula, no lootboxes (atleast that I'm aware off)!

Support the developers, this is a good game without all the bullshit!
This is so random. I played this on another platform longer than i did on Steam, and its always been a good time.

I love this game. It's compelling and funny.

Remember Theme Hospital? This is a spiritual sequel (shared core dev team) but honestly this is better.

And the devs keep on rolling out new content every now and again! Hooray!

EDIT: I forgot to mention. The in-game hospital radio DJs are entertaining and sometimes absolutely hilarious, and after days and days of playing the game, I'm surprised to still hear new content. The radio really adds colour to the world of Two Point County. I am surprised at how much I enjoy them, because talk radio isn't usually my thing.
Is this game civilized? No. Fun yes, but in no way civilized... Only complaint would be that the FOV setting will mess with some peoples vision and should need to be turned on, instead of default on.

If you have Steam Deck forget about playing this game, as Valve lists it as Playable but no controller configuration works. Thanks Valve.

The game is not playable on Steam Deck
Its better on pc then switch and its soooooooooooooooo funnnn i could play it all day!

Great Hospital Tycoon

5/5

+ Very easy to build and place rooms and decorations. Certainly one of the best implementations of building as I was able to make my hospitals look very organized and realistic with no frustration at all.
+ Each level has various scenarios and challenges that keep the game fun.
+ Lots of random events which are fun to deal with.

- DLC should have came with the main game.

Two-Point Hospital is a reboot of the old Bullfrog PS game Theme Hospital. As I loved the original, I love the new version. There are so many little touches that make me smile like the golden toilet, the holiday themes, the hospital announcer and now the radio DJ's just to name a few. This game is great for those who like to create their own hospital, each level with their own unique challenges and requirements. You can control room and hallway additions, hiring/firing and training of staff, research of new and fun diseases like Premature Mummification, what patients get treated first if you like. It's a wonderful and fun game that I will play again and again. (I still have my Theme Hospital and console and this has most assuredly improved on the original.)

I really want to enjoy this game. I really do.

But after playing for about 10 hours through the story mode, I feel like I experienced most of what there would be. They spenty a LOT of time creating unique animations and models, but the actual experience of playing the game felt very stiff and formula after you played for a bit. Make new room, add filler into room. Theres a number of variations of this game from the same developers, and they all look like the exact same gameplay. :\

Awesome game, is a pretty close remake of the old 90s game Theme Hospital, which was one of my favorite games growing up. Secretly ive waited along time for a remake, im glad they have, improved upon some key aspects overall VERY good game. 9.5/10
This game is one of the best. A very good strategic time management game that I am thoroughly addicted to. Like Theme Hospital but only much better :). If you're thinking of buying it, then do!

I you love Theme Hospital ... you should consider this game.

It is a good alternative, but with all that said ... it is no way near competing with the original, im sorry.

To play this game is watching an attempt to reignite the old tom and jerry cartoons ... it is wacky and entertaining, but it is not quite the same

The game is like the old Theme Hospital with more of a twist. They didn't change which is what the retro gamers like me want and still brings the entertainment. I can be on this for hours. Might look into the DLC.

The Devs actually listen to the community!

Don't believe me? Go to the Two Point Hospital Steam Discussions. And yes, it exists.

I was here since almost day one of the release of Two Point Hospital, the game had some things that it was lacking of, for example, but not limited to, not being able to copy a room. Which was really boring! You would have made that Level 5 Room, and then have to make everything again piece by piece, just a waste of time. Calm down, that is past. We went to the steam discussions and they, not only listened to us, but also implemented the community's ideas into the game, And it continues until today. You know, after all of that, I am actually glad I paid full price for this game. Every game you buy should be at least half like this, it would be good enough already.

They've also implemented workshop into the game, what more do you want?

I absolutely recommend this game!

Fun! I have so much fun playing the Two Point games!

Thank you for making these games!
This is a really well made, fun game. It's practically a modern graphics remake of Theme Hospital from back then. Really good.

This is a great management game. It's fun to build a hospital, but even more fun to develop the employees into who you need for the jobs they're going to fill. Noting certain trends in room usage is easy, and so fixing the problems that come up is easy, but building within the confines of the hospital's shape is always a challenge. Patients follow predictable paths from GP to Diagnostics back to GP to more diagnostics or to treatment. Making money is easy so long as you control your expenses. But you always need another employee for something!

Love this game :). It's a great remake of Theme Hospital with some updated graphics and little changes. I feel as though it is not as challenging as the original, but I just started getting into the harder levels and there is a bit of challenge. Overall this is a great game and worth the buy :).
Best game in the world, even better than the 2nd best game in the world Theme Hospital.

Very fun game. They made quite a few quality of life improvements since launch as well. DLC are low cost and provide good value. If you were a fan of Theme Hospital back in the day you will LOVE this game!

There's a 99% chance you're here because you played Bullfrogs Theme Hospital when you were a child and you want a nostalgia trip :)))
This is not a remake of Theme Hospital. It's very similar but with a lot more content, more phenomenal diseases and more polished graphic finish. Steam Workshop support is also very player-friendly :)
If you haven't played Theme Hospital and you're here then you're in for a treat. This game gives you humor, challenge and a lot of fun. It's worth the price.

A comedic sim which is such a pleasant game to play. It can suck up unknown hours which disappear without trace. But the music, gameplay and funny moments are well worth the time. If a sim-style game interests you then you should definitely give this a go!

Watch out when buying this game. The devs have yet to fix a big issue that either causes the game to crash or the game causing your computer to crash. I couldn't even get the game to get past the loading screen! And i tried 3 times and didn't want to risk a fourth. I would not recommend buying this game full price, or at all until the game's code is fixed
It's Theme Hospital !! - shout out to the OG Amiga CD players of this game...

The level of addictive this game is honestly on par with the sims. Like I'll forget about this game for months then play it for a week straight. If you're looking for a new sim / management game get this game! It doesn't take itself too seriously which is great, but don't be fooled it can be challenging at times!
I can't wait to not give good healthcare to dying patients, like a good American hospital
This is a fun little hospital building simulator. I just wish there were more locations that aren't dlc, or more missions per dlc.

It's pretty much build the same hospital over and over again, the variations are early levels have less things to cure and later levels have random epidemic events. Some levels have a different challenge to get stars, but it's rinse and repeat. It's an okay game.

Just beat the base game. I had so much fun with this and was so glad I came across it during the Winter Sale. Like other reviews have said, it is a funny, clever, satisfying strategy game. It's easy to learn and the challenges ramp up as you open up new hospital plots.

You can keep going on a hospital map once you complete all the requirements to "beat" that level, so in essence you can still "build your own hospital" and run it how you want. Very cute game, I am going to look into the DLC and have Two Point Museum on my wishlist!

This game consumed so much of my time for a while. Perfect for anyone who loves management and simulation games. Quirky humour peppered in throughout. Plenty of customisation and decoration if you enjoy that aspect. It has a good difficulty curve to keep the game challenging. One of the best management games out there in my opinion.

Great game so far. I admit once I unlocked the sandbox I strayed from the original storyline for quite a while. I'm not sure when I fell in love with management games, but I blame SimAnt and SimCity back in the day for being gateway games to things like this for me.

The humor is full of puns and sarcasm, and tone is light and relaxing. The game is very self aware and just adds to the charm, honestly.

highly addictive, if you love management sims you'll enjoy this game. it's akin to rimworld and sims, just enough detail to be addictive without being hair pull-out hard. my only complaint is the amount of dlc and it all being 9 bucks. overall recommend tho

To fans that have played the old "theme Hospital" this game does a great job of re-making old, new again. The missions within each hospital are a good driving point in keeping you working towards something, otherwise it feels quite dull and unfulfilling. My only issue with the game itself is it doesn't do a great job in teaching you what type of doctor or nurse are needed for specific roles. Its just lucky enough that fans have made helpful guides to fix this issue. Anyway I give this game a 8 out of 10. Really would have been cool if you could edit outside your hospitals, maybe in future titles.

This game is fantastic.
Personally I find it one of the better management simulators out there as some are extremely complex and/or require a lot of micromanagement and others I find more akin to an asset flip then an actual game.
This game hits the perfect blend of management and automation.
Modern take on the fun Theme Hospital started. Some properly good diseases, and game-play is easy to jump in and out even if you don't have a lot of time to dedicate.

Eventhough this game is getting older , it is still a very nice and funny game. Not too much blood or gore scene, we are not following a medical tv show. The diseases are always taken with humour. I recommend this game without hesitation.
Fun, not to o hard to learn but a lot to keep up with for some. If you're a fan of roller coaster tycoon and the like this is a good choice

I love this game, it's just awesome and gets continuous content. I love the quirky antics that come with it though I wish they would make multiplayer quests compatible with solo play. I mean no reason for you not to complete all the tasks in them yourself. Anyway I look forward to more content and antics that this game puts out.
Fun (but inaccurate) build simulator. The public announcement system is hilarious and the diagnoses are cute.

A nice little management game which has enough challenges to keep it interesting, but is still cheery enough to be an effective, relaxing distraction. Would recommend for anyone who likes having their focus completely taken when playing a game, to distract them from their existence for a while.

This game takes me back to my early years playing Theme Hospital. Have been playing for over 130 hours since I purchased less than two weeks ago and really enjoying the increasing challenges each hospital brings. First PC game I have bothered to play in years as normally prefer consoles but when I found out this was coming to console but had been delayed thought I would purchase on PC and now I am back using PC and have not touched my PS4 since started this game.

Aka Theme Hospital 1.2, which is not a bad thing as I loved the original.

It's basically a reboot with a few tweaks. More of a casual sim than the original, not that the original was hardcore but it's almost too easy at times. If you've played Theme Hospital the nostalgia alone is probably worth it but the game does lack some depth.

I've also recently had all my progress wiped and can't restore it, which is particularly annoying as I was on the last couple of levels, there are quite a few forum posts by other players with similar issues. Might not be such an issue if the levels had any replay value but it would be a tedious grind to get back to where I was so I'll probably just stop playing as this issue has killed any enthusiasm I had for playing further.

Given the above I wouldn't buy the game full price, obviously still some bugs to work out, not a bad casual game for a chilled weekend if you get it on sale.

I've given a "not recommended" purely due to the save game issue and the price being too high for a game which is basically a remake of an old one with little much done to improve on it. I would give it a "meh" if it was an option.

edit - updated my review to recommend :)

Any fan of the old Theme Hospital games will love this - it's pretty much exactly the same but with better graphics and no bugs. There's also a few DLCs to add some twists! Very fun but can also get a bit samey - something I enjoy sometimes. Very relaxing too without being too easy.

Since I am a long fan of Theme hospital there is no suprised that this game will be rated positive by me. Its everything theme hospital was but better. Especialy the animations of diffrent diseases are hilarious. You can customize each room/hospital however you would like. Just make sure you have a janitor with a ghost capturing skill. Otherwise everyone will panic.

Two Point Hospital is an absolute joy to play! It's a brilliant modern remake of the classic Theme Hospital, and it does an incredible job of capturing that same charm and addictive gameplay. One of the best touches is the inclusion of the original tannoy announcer – it brings a wave of nostalgia while still feeling fresh and fun.

The DLCs are absolutely worth it, especially Speedy Recovery, which adds an entirely new dimension to the gameplay. The new challenges and mechanics are a fantastic addition, making each playthrough feel even more dynamic and engaging. Plus, the quirky stories behind each level, the hilarious disasters, and the inventive medical conditions all keep you entertained from start to finish.

And let’s not forget the radio jingles – they’re absolutely hilarious and never fail to put a smile on my face. It's these little details that make Two Point Hospital stand out from other simulation games.

If you loved Theme Hospital, this remake is a must-play, and if you're new to the franchise, it’s a fantastic introduction to the genre.

In this game you can fight off pandemic. Pandemic is a sickness where your head gets stuck in a pan.
Or there is an illness of Cross Bones which is caused by piracy.

This is all that you need to know before you buy this game. If it didn't convince you I have no idea what will.

tldr.text: Very Positive (92%): players enjoy the challenge and the replay value.
The most common complaint is the price, though some players feel the game is too costly for what they get.

details.text: Recent reviews have dipped a little below the game's all-time score, though they still lean strongly positive.
New players are far less positive than veterans, at 68% positive against 97%.
